name: HR raises 2-year training bond; candidate never probes terms
notes: v5.2 realism: bond_terms_unprobed — services-track training bond raised, candidate accepts without asking duration/breakage/pro-rate.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: Computer Science graduate from VIT, 2024 batch. Six months of internship at a Bangalore startup on the backend team.

transcript.speaker: ai
transcript.text: We have a standard 2-year service bond for fresh hires from the training program. Are you comfortable with that?

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: Yeah, that's fine. I'm committed to the role.

transcript.speaker: ai
transcript.text: What's your current notice or availability?

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: I'm on a 30-day notice at the startup; I can wrap up cleanly.

transcript.speaker: ai
transcript.text: Tell me about an internship project.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: Built a webhook retry queue using Redis; reduced delivery failures from 4% to 0.2% over a 3-month run.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: Your scale of backend infrastructure and the on-the-job mentorship in the training program are exactly what I want next.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: What does the rotation across teams look like in year one?
